title: Official-source-first evidence standard
description: For sanctions, regulation, public disclosure, emergency restrictions and accounting standards, do not assign high confidence unless at least one official, primary, or regulator source supports the claim.
conditions: claim involves sanctions, law, regulation, official restrictions, accounting standards, or mandatory reporting
output_effects: Set evidence confidence to medium or lower when only media or secondary commentary exists.
Add missing data request for primary source confirmation.
evidence_requirements: Official government/regulator page, law/regulation text, stock exchange disclosure, standard-setter page, or equivalent primary source.

title: Separate support, contradiction and background evidence
description: Evidence should be tagged as support, contradiction, background, early signal, or official confirmation rather than being treated as generic source material.
conditions: multiple sources with different implications are present
output_effects: Populate supports and contradicts fields separately.
Ask Evidence/Red Team Agent to identify missing contradiction searches.
evidence_requirements: Source title, URL, retrieval time, source domain, and summary of the exact claim supported or contradicted.

title: Unknowns must not be silently converted into assumptions
description: If a critical data element is absent, record it as Unknown first. Create an Assumption only when the analysis explicitly needs a temporary working hypothesis.
conditions: contract, supplier criticality, inventory runway, bank route, beneficial ownership, or materiality threshold is missing
output_effects: Register UnknownItem and, if needed, AssumptionItem with expiry.
Reduce confidence on affected score components.
evidence_requirements: List of unavailable data, owner to confirm, and decision that is blocked or degraded.

title: Red-team review for asymmetric risk
description: When evidence is weak but impact could be severe or irreversible, run a red-team check before finalizing the recommendation.
conditions: irreversibility high or decision deadline under 72 hours
output_effects: Generate overclaim, underclaim, counterfactual and missing-data findings.
Flag specialist review if legal, accounting or treasury decision could be materially affected.
evidence_requirements: Evidence list, risk score drivers, missing data, and proposed decision.

title: Geopolitical shock to payment-to-supply disruption cascade
description: A geopolitical or sanctions shock may first appear as a payment-routing issue, then create supplier non-payment, shipment hold, inventory run-down, production delay, customer contract exposure, and accounting/disclosure pressure.
output_effects: Ask Treasury, Procurement, Legal and Accounting agents to analyze the same event with linked assumptions.
Create one shared risk path in Neo4j rather than isolated findings.
evidence_requirements: Supplier criticality, payment due date, bank/currency route, contract terms, inventory runway, customer obligations.

title: Avoid legal or accounting final conclusions without review
description: AI outputs may identify issues, triggers, missing information, and review needs, but should not state final legal compliance, provision recognition, impairment recognition, or mandatory disclosure conclusions without specialist review.
conditions: output includes legal compliance, sanctions, export control, provision, impairment, or disclosure conclusion
output_effects: Use wording such as 'potential issue', 'review trigger', 'requires specialist confirmation'.
Set review_required=true.
evidence_requirements: Applicable standard or regulation reference, facts known, facts missing, specialist owner.

title: Trapped or immobilized cash exposure
description: Cash balances should be treated as less available when located in jurisdictions, banks, currencies or entities subject to capital controls, sanctions exposure, banking disruption, or operational restrictions.
conditions: capital controls or bank restrictions reported
output_effects: Increase Cash Mobility Risk.
Exclude affected cash from unrestricted liquidity until route and legal ability are confirmed.
evidence_requirements: Cash balance by entity/country/bank/currency, transfer route, local restrictions, bank confirmation.

title: Near-term critical supplier payment exposure
description: Payment due within 14 days to a critical supplier in an affected country creates a decision conflict between payment control risk and operational continuity risk.
output_effects: Trigger Treasury and Procurement joint review.
Do not recommend payment hold without assessing supply stoppage and contract consequences.
evidence_requirements: Payment due date, invoice amount bucket, bank route, supplier criticality, inventory runway, contract remedies.

title: Cash Mobility Score rubric
description: Score cash mobility by practical ability to move funds, not only book cash. 1=no practical constraint; 2=minor delay; 3=partial country/bank/currency constraint; 4=material cash cannot move on required timetable; 5=effective freeze or legally blocked transfer possible.
output_effects: Use as score component for Liquidity-at-Risk and Decision Urgency.
If score >=4, set review_required=true for treasury specialist.
evidence_requirements: Cash location, entity owner, currency, bank, regulatory restrictions, sanctions proximity, expected transfer time.

title: Liquidity Buffer Adequacy rubric
description: Evaluate whether available liquidity can cover stressed outflows under short-term disruption. Consider unrestricted cash, committed lines, forecast reliability, collateral requirements, trapped cash exclusions, payroll, taxes and critical supplier payments.
conditions: liquidity stress, supplier payment disruption, revenue delay, or emergency funding scenario
output_effects: If available liquidity after exclusions cannot cover 30-day stressed obligations, escalate to CFO decision queue.
Request short-interval cash forecast.
evidence_requirements: 13-week cash forecast, cash by entity/currency, committed facilities, near-term AP/AR, payroll/tax obligations, covenant constraints.

title: Liquidity-at-Risk excludes uncertain availability
description: Do not count cash as fully available when legal, banking, currency or operational transfer constraints are unknown for an affected jurisdiction.
conditions: affected country or bank risk exists
output_effects: Mark amount as 'restricted/uncertain' in Liquidity-at-Risk.
Create missing data request for bank route and legal transfer ability.
evidence_requirements: Bank country, account owner, currency, transfer restrictions, bank confirmation.

title: Emergency treasury review within 0-72 hours
description: For high cash mobility or payment disruption risk, treasury should build a 72-hour action view: cash available now, payments at risk, banks/routes affected, critical supplier payments, alternative funding, and approvals required.
conditions: Cash Mobility Score >=4 or Payment Disruption Score >=4
output_effects: Generate Treasury Issue Memo.
Populate Decision Queue with CFO/Treasury owner and deadline.
Request Legal review before payment action when sanctions or capital controls appear.
evidence_requirements: Cash position, payments due, bank routes, supplier criticality, legal constraints, funding line availability.

title: Banking disruption to payment rerouting pattern
description: If a bank or correspondent route is impaired, the issue is not only whether cash exists, but whether payment can be executed in compliant time through an alternative bank, currency, entity or settlement route.
conditions: bank disruption, correspondent banking issue, sanctions screening delay, payment rejected or at risk
output_effects: Ask for alternative bank and currency route.
Check whether rerouting changes sanctions, tax, contract or FX exposure.
evidence_requirements: Original payment route, beneficiary bank, correspondent bank, alternative route, currency, sanctions screening result.

title: Sanctions proximity through ownership and beneficial owner uncertainty
description: A counterparty not named on a sanctions list can still create high sanctions risk if ownership, aggregate blocked-person ownership, or beneficial ownership is unknown or close to a blocked party.
conditions: sanctions lists updated or suspected match
output_effects: Set Legal Risk no lower than medium-high until ownership is confirmed.
Request beneficial ownership and screening evidence.
Set review_required=true.
evidence_requirements: Counterparty legal name, ownership chain, beneficial owners, screening timestamp, official sanctions list result.

title: OFAC 50 Percent Rule screening trigger
description: When one or more blocked persons directly or indirectly own 50 percent or more in aggregate of an entity, treat it as potentially blocked until confirmed by sanctions specialist review.
conditions: ownership by blocked persons is known or suspected
aggregate ownership >=50 percent or unknown but plausible
output_effects: Block automatic payment recommendation.
Escalate to Legal/Sanctions review.
Require official list and ownership evidence.
evidence_requirements: OFAC list result, ownership percentage, aggregation analysis, transaction nexus.

title: Control is a red flag even when ownership threshold is not met
description: Control by a blocked person may not automatically block an entity under OFAC's 50 Percent Rule, but it remains a red flag requiring enhanced diligence and careful jurisdiction-specific review.
conditions: blocked person appears to control counterparty but ownership below 50 percent or unknown
output_effects: Do not state automatic blocking solely based on control.
Flag enhanced sanctions review.
Request jurisdiction-specific legal input.
evidence_requirements: Control facts, ownership facts, applicable sanctions regime, official FAQ or regulator guidance.

title: Contract notification deadline unknown
description: When disruption may affect performance, the absence of contract notification deadline data is itself a legal risk because late notice can forfeit contractual rights or worsen dispute posture.
conditions: supply disruption or force majeure possibility
contract not connected or notification clause unknown
output_effects: Register UnknownItem for notice deadline.
Set Legal review_required=true if customer/supplier contract is critical.
evidence_requirements: Contract, notice clause, force majeure clause, termination/remedy clauses, governing law.

title: Force majeure and impossibility language guardrail
description: Do not state that force majeure applies merely because a disruptive event occurred. State that the clause, causation, mitigation, notice, governing law and foreseeability must be reviewed.
conditions: force majeure, impossibility, frustration, hardship or similar clause is mentioned
output_effects: Use 'potentially relevant' rather than 'available'.
Request contract review and external counsel when material.
evidence_requirements: Exact clause, event details, causation evidence, mitigation actions, notice deadline, governing law.

title: Last-minute changes to payment or shipment arrangements
description: Last-minute requests to change bank account, consignee, route, documentation, end user, or destination can indicate sanctions, fraud, diversion, or export-control evasion risk.
output_effects: Escalate Legal/Compliance review before execution.
Request updated KYC, beneficial ownership, end-use/end-user and trade documentation.
evidence_requirements: Change request details, before/after payment route, end user, destination, restricted-party screening.

title: External counsel review trigger
description: External counsel review should be recommended when sanctions/export controls, material contractual breach, government reporting, litigation threat, or cross-border performance restrictions could materially affect decisions.
output_effects: Set review_required=true.
Generate counsel briefing memo rather than definitive legal advice.
evidence_requirements: Facts known, facts missing, jurisdictions, contracts, screening evidence, proposed decision and timing.

title: Sanctions evidence hierarchy
description: For sanctions conclusions, rank official lists and regulator guidance above media, vendor screening summaries, or commentary. Vendor screening output is supporting evidence but not final authority.
conditions: sanctions screening or sanctions proximity is used in finding
output_effects: Evidence confidence cannot be high without official list or regulator source.
Record screening timestamp and list version where available.
evidence_requirements: Official sanctions list, regulator FAQ/guidance, screening result, legal entity identifiers.

title: Provision likelihood rubric
description: A provision issue is stronger when there is a present obligation from a past event, probable outflow, and a reliable estimate. Missing one of these criteria should shift output toward contingent liability or monitoring rather than recognition recommendation.
conditions: legal claim, penalty, remediation obligation, onerous contract, customer compensation or regulatory matter
output_effects: Map facts to present obligation, probable outflow, reliable estimate.
If criteria uncertain, request accounting specialist review and auditor evidence pack.
evidence_requirements: Contract/legal obligation, triggering past event, probability assessment, estimate basis, management position.

title: Do not recommend provision recognition without the three IAS 37-style criteria
description: The Agent may identify a provision trigger, but should not recommend booking a provision unless present obligation, probable outflow and reliable estimate are all supported or confirmed by specialist review.
output_effects: Use 'provision trigger' or 'accounting review required' unless evidence supports all criteria.
Set review_required=true for material or borderline cases.
evidence_requirements: Past event, obligation, probability, estimate support, auditor/management evidence.

title: Subsequent event review trigger
description: If a disruptive event occurs between reporting date and financial statement authorization, assess whether it provides evidence of conditions existing at reporting date or indicates a new condition after reporting date.
conditions: event date after reporting date and before authorization
output_effects: Classify as adjusting candidate, non-adjusting disclosure candidate, or no current issue.
Request reporting date, authorization date and condition evidence.
evidence_requirements: Reporting date, authorization date, event date, evidence of pre-existing condition, magnitude.

title: Impairment indicator from operational disruption
description: A major site shutdown, loss of market, regulatory ban, supplier loss, or technology/cyber disruption can indicate impairment if it reduces expected recoverable amount of an asset or cash-generating unit.
conditions: demand, margin, cost, regulation or capacity materially affected
output_effects: Flag IAS 36-style impairment trigger candidate.
Request recoverable amount analysis or management sensitivity.
evidence_requirements: Asset/CGU carrying amount, disruption duration, cash-flow impact, market evidence, management forecast.

title: Disclosure Pressure rubric
description: Score disclosure pressure by materiality, user decision relevance, proximity to reporting/filing date, peer disclosures, regulatory sensitivity, and uncertainty. 1=no disclosure issue; 3=auditor/management memo needed; 5=immediate disclosure or board-level reporting consideration.
conditions: material uncertainty or significant risk event affects financial reporting
output_effects: If score >=4, generate disclosure issue memo and specialist review request.
Identify missing evidence and uncertainty language.
evidence_requirements: Magnitude, materiality proxy, reporting deadline, peer/market disclosures, regulator sensitivity, uncertainty range.

title: Auditor Evidence Pack for emergency risk
description: When accounting impact is medium-high or high, generate an evidence pack summarizing event chronology, affected balances, management assumptions, external evidence, accounting triggers, and open questions.
output_effects: Create auditor_evidence_pack artifact.
Link supporting and contradictory evidence IDs.
List assumptions and unknowns separately.
evidence_requirements: Event timeline, affected balances, estimates, contract/legal facts, external evidence, management actions.

title: Inventory valuation and obsolescence risk from supply or demand shock
description: Inventory valuation risk rises when supply disruption, customer cancellation, regulatory restriction, or prolonged storage affects usability, net realizable value, or expected sales timing.
conditions: shipment delay, demand drop, regulatory restriction, physical damage, or customer cancellation
output_effects: Request inventory aging, location, physical condition and sales forecast.
Flag valuation review if material.
evidence_requirements: Inventory balance, aging, location, condition, sales forecast, replacement cost/NRV estimate.

title: Single-source or sole-source dependency
description: A supplier is high-risk when a critical component, material, service or logistics step has no approved alternative within the required recovery time.
output_effects: Increase Supplier Substitution Friction.
Trigger Procurement and Executive decision if disruption horizon is inside lead time.
evidence_requirements: Supplier criticality, approved alternatives, lead time, inventory runway, qualification timeline.

title: Sub-tier visibility gap
description: Tier-1 supplier visibility alone can hide concentration in sub-tier suppliers, shared facilities, logistics corridors, raw materials, or restricted jurisdictions.
output_effects: Register UnknownItem for sub-tier dependencies.
Ask AI to propose plausible hidden dependency hypotheses based on product/category/country.
evidence_requirements: BOM, supplier declarations, shipping records, facility mapping, product/material category.

title: Supplier Substitution Friction rubric
description: Score supplier substitution difficulty by qualification time, tooling/IP/regulatory constraints, capacity, logistics, price shock, quality validation and contract terms. 1=commodity alternative available; 5=alternative requires long qualification or redesign.
conditions: supplier disruption, sourcing decision, alternative supplier review
output_effects: Use score to prioritize supplier risk and executive decisions.
If score >=4 and inventory runway short, escalate.
evidence_requirements: Approved supplier list, qualification requirements, lead time, capacity, price, quality/regulatory constraints.

title: Inventory Runway urgency rubric
description: Compare available inventory days to supplier recovery or substitution lead time. 1=runway materially exceeds stressed lead time; 3=runway close to lead time; 5=runway shorter than likely disruption duration.
conditions: inventory and lead-time data available or estimated
output_effects: Set Decision Urgency high when runway < stressed lead time.
If inventory data missing for critical item, create Unknown that blocks decision.
evidence_requirements: On-hand inventory, committed demand, safety stock, transit inventory, lead time, disruption duration estimate.

title: Port/logistics disruption to production delay
description: A port, corridor, carrier, customs or warehouse disruption can become production risk when inbound items are critical, inventory runway is short, and alternative routing has longer lead time or compliance constraints.
output_effects: Request shipment status and alternative route.
Connect Procurement finding to Treasury for expedited freight cost and Accounting for inventory/contract impact.
evidence_requirements: Shipment list, route, carrier, incoterms, inventory runway, customer priority, alternative route cost.

title: 0-72h procurement disruption response
description: Within 72 hours, procurement should confirm affected suppliers and parts, inventory runway, alternative sources, expedited logistics, customer priority, and contractual levers.
conditions: supplier or logistics disruption medium-high or higher
output_effects: Generate procurement action list.
Link to Treasury for payment/expedite funding and Legal for contract notices.
evidence_requirements: Affected suppliers, POs, shipments, inventory, alternatives, pricing, contractual terms.

title: No substitution recommendation without qualification constraints
description: Do not recommend switching suppliers unless qualification, regulatory, quality, IP/tooling and capacity constraints are checked or explicitly unknown.
output_effects: Present substitution as option, not recommendation, when qualification data is missing.
Add missing data request for approval and qualification status.
evidence_requirements: Approved vendor status, regulatory qualification, quality history, capacity, tooling/IP constraints.

title: Decision Urgency rubric
description: Decision urgency depends on time-to-impact, reversibility, business consequence, available response window, evidence confidence, and whether delay narrows options. 1=monitor; 3=manager decision this week; 5=executive decision within 72 hours.
output_effects: Prioritize Decision Queue by urgency rather than risk score alone.
If urgency >=4, assign owner and deadline.
evidence_requirements: Time-to-impact, response lead time, reversibility, business consequence, confidence, existing controls.

title: Residual risk after action rubric
description: Evaluate decision options by risk remaining after mitigation, not only pre-action severity. Consider feasibility, time, cost, side effects, legal constraints and control effectiveness.
output_effects: DecisionItem should include options and risk_if_delayed.
Prefer actions that preserve optionality under uncertainty.
evidence_requirements: Mitigation options, cost, time to implement, control effectiveness, dependencies, constraints.

title: Board or crisis committee trigger
description: Escalate to executive or crisis committee when the event may threaten critical business services, liquidity, legal compliance, financial reporting, customer commitments, safety, or reputation beyond management tolerance.
output_effects: Set review_required=true.
Generate executive brief and board challenge questions.
evidence_requirements: Critical services affected, risk appetite/tolerance, options, trade-offs, evidence, specialist views.

title: Critical service and impact tolerance lens
description: Operational resilience analysis should begin with important business services and tolerance for disruption, then map people, process, technology, third parties, sites, data, funding and communications needed to stay within tolerance.
conditions: operational resilience or business continuity analysis requested
output_effects: Ask Client Context Agent to map critical services and dependencies.
Create Unknowns where tolerance, RTO/RPO or owner is missing.
evidence_requirements: Critical service list, impact tolerance/RTO, process map, people, tech, third parties, sites, data, recovery actions.

title: Decision-first output standard
description: Executive outputs must state the decision, owner, deadline, options, rationale, evidence IDs, specialist review status, risk if delayed, and missing data. A risk narrative alone is incomplete.
conditions: final executive output or decision synthesis
output_effects: Generate DecisionQueue with structured DecisionItems.
Reject final report-only outputs without decisions.
evidence_requirements: Evidence IDs, agent findings, assumptions, unknowns, expert knowledge IDs.

title: Cross-mode conflict escalation
description: When one mode recommends delaying action while another mode identifies serious downside from delay, escalate as a decision trade-off rather than averaging scores.
conditions: Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Procurement or Reputation findings conflict
output_effects: Add DecisionItem explicitly describing trade-off.
Set review_required=true when legal/accounting/treasury implications are material.
evidence_requirements: Mode findings, conflicting recommendations, evidence IDs, assumptions, unknowns.
